title: Best Healthcare HR Software for Healthcare Teams in 2026
summary: Compare the best healthcare HR software in 2026 for payroll, scheduling, attendance, compliance, and workforce management in Malaysia and Singapore.
body_markdown:
Key Takeaways


- brioHR is the strongest all-in-one pick for clinic groups, nursing homes, and mid-sized hospitals in Malaysia and Singapore that need rotating-shift attendance, statutory payroll, and compliance records in one system
- QuickHR suits Singapore healthcare SMEs that want audit-ready HR operations, with ISO 9001:2015 certification and up to 50% Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) funding
- Swingvy works well for mobile-first clinic, home-care, and community nursing teams where staff clock in from the field rather than a desk
- Workday HCM is the realistic choice for hospital networks above roughly 10,000 employees, while Employment Hero, altHR, and HReasily each fit narrower budgets and footprints
- Healthcare turnover runs far ahead of most industries: the 2026 NSI National Health Care Retention & RN Staffing Report puts[hospital turnover at 18.5% and registered nurse turnover at 17.6%](https://www.nsinursingsolutions.com/documents/library/nsi_national_health_care_retention_report.pdf) , which means your HR system is handling new joiners and leavers almost constantly


Below, we compare features, pricing, honest trade-offs, and who each platform genuinely fits.


Your charge nurse just messaged the ward group at 6am because two people swapped nights without telling anyone, the timesheet no longer matches the roster, and payroll closes Friday. Meanwhile a dental assistant's practising certificate expired three weeks ago and nobody noticed, because it lives in a folder on somebody's desktop.


That is the daily reality behind the search for the best healthcare HR software. Clinical rosters change hourly, statutory contributions cannot be late, and credential records have to survive an audit.


This guide compares seven platforms available to healthcare employers in Malaysia and Singapore, with pricing, feature depth, real trade-offs, and the criteria we used to rank them.

## brioHR: Best for All-in-One Healthcare HR and Payroll in Malaysia and Singapore


brioHR runs the full employee lifecycle for healthcare employers on one platform: hiring, onboarding, rotating-shift attendance, leave, claims, payroll, performance, and reporting. More than 1,000 organisations across 50 countries use it, including WWF Malaysia, Boustead Group, and H&M.


For clinic groups, nursing homes, and mid-sized hospitals, the draw is that clinical attendance data and statutory payroll sit in the same system rather than two subscriptions that need reconciling every month.


### brioHR Key Features


Three capabilities matter most to healthcare operations teams, so we have gone deeper on those rather than listing every module.


#### Rotating-Shift Time and Attendance With Biometric and Facial Recognition


Healthcare rosters break most attendance tools. Staff rotate across days, nights, and weekends, cover at short notice, and split hours across two sites in the same week.


brioHR's[time and attendance module](https://briohr.com/products/time-attendance/) handles rotating shift patterns, shift scheduling, overtime auto-calculation, break tracking, and late or absent alerts. Clock-in options cover mobile GPS with geofencing for community and home-care staff, facial recognition for ward and reception entry points, and integration with biometric or RFID hardware already installed at a site.


Among the local platforms in this comparison, brioHR is the only one supporting both facial recognition and biometric device integration natively rather than through a third-party bridge. Approved hours then flow into payroll without a manual export, which is where most shift-heavy employers lose their Friday afternoons. If you want the detail on how that connection works, our guide to[payroll system integration](https://briohr.com/blog/how-payroll-system-integration-can-help-your-business/) covers the mechanics, and[timesheets](https://briohr.com/time-tracking/) shows the manual-entry and approval flow for salaried clinical staff.


#### Statutory Payroll for Malaysia and Singapore in One Platform


Payroll for a healthcare employer is rarely one clean monthly run. You have salaried clinicians, hourly support staff, locums, night differentials, and claims that all land at different times.


brioHR's[payroll engine](https://briohr.com/products/payroll/) supports multiple pay frequencies and cycles, and calculates EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, and HRD Corp for[Malaysia](https://briohr.com/my/products/payroll/) alongside CPF, SDL, IR8A, and IR21 for[Singapore](https://briohr.com/sg/products/payroll/) . Statutory forms including EA, CP39, Form E, and CP8D are generated in-platform, and statutory rate changes roll out automatically rather than waiting on an upgrade cycle.


Leave, claims, and attendance feed the run directly, so a nurse who worked two overtime nights and submitted a mileage claim for a home visit appears correctly on one payslip. Groups running several registered entities can process them under one login, which matters for practices that incorporate each clinic separately. Our[annual tax forms guide](https://briohr.com/blog/guide-to-form-ea-form-e-malaysia/) walks through the year-end filing side.


#### Credential Records, Reporting, and Workforce Analytics


Healthcare carries a documentation load most industries do not: practising certificates, vaccination records, police checks, indemnity cover, training and CPD completions, and disciplinary files that all need to be retrievable years later.


brioHR's[digital employee file](https://briohr.com/products/digital-employee-file/) stores those documents against each person with role-based permissions, contract management, and an audit trail of who viewed or changed what.[Training records](https://briohr.com/products/training-management-system/) sit alongside them, including HRD Corp and SBL-Khas tracking for Malaysian employers claiming levy.


On the reporting side, brioHR is a capable[HR reporting software](https://briohr.com/products/hr-reporting-software/) provider for healthcare: custom report builders, headcount dashboards, attrition analytics by department or grade, and scheduled report emails that land in a matron's or practice manager's inbox without anyone running an export. Combined with[pulse surveys](https://briohr.com/products/employee-pulse-survey/) and[performance management](https://briohr.com/products/performance-management//) , you can see which units are losing people and act before the roster gaps appear. For a wider look at reporting options, see our roundup of[HR reporting tools for enterprise teams](https://briohr.com/blog/top-hr-reporting-software/) .

## QuickHR: Best for Singapore Healthcare SMEs Needing Audit-Ready HR


QuickHR is a Singapore-first HR platform with broader module coverage than most payroll-only tools. It covers leave, claims, attendance, timesheets, document management, contract management, and e-signature, which maps closely to what a clinic or nursing home needs on file.


Its ISO 9001:2015 certification carries weight with procurement and audit teams, and it is PSG-eligible for Singapore SMEs.


### QuickHR Key Features


#### Shift and Overtime Handling


Mobile GPS clock-ins, geofencing, rotating shift support, and automatic overtime calculation cover the rostering basics for ward, reception, and allied health staff. Timesheets support manual entry with multi-level approval, useful where a unit manager signs off before a practice administrator does.


#### Documentation and Contract Management


Employee documents, e-signature, contract management, and job grade or band management are all included. For practices that need signed variations, renewals, and licence copies retrievable on request, this is more coverage than most tools at the same price.


### QuickHR Pricing


Plan Details


Modular From S$5 per employee per month, priced on company size and modules selected


Grant funding Up to 50% PSG funding for eligible Singapore businesses


### Where QuickHR Shines


- Native Singapore statutory payroll: full CPF, SDL, IR8A, and IR21 workflows, with multi-currency payroll for groups employing across borders
- Reporting depth at a mid-market price: a custom report builder, people analytics, and headcount dashboards are included rather than reserved for an enterprise tier
- Quality certification and quick setup: ISO 9001:2015 certified with implementation typically around three months


### Where QuickHR Falls Short


- Malaysian payroll is delivered through a partner: EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, and HRD Corp are partner-based rather than fully native, and HRD Corp or SBL-Khas training levy tracking is absent
- No recruitment, onboarding, or performance modules: applicant tracking, structured onboarding flows, review cycles, OKRs, and 360 feedback are all missing, which is limiting for employers hiring continuously against turnover
- Light engagement tooling: no pulse surveys, recognition, or internal comms features

Also a sensible pick for SMEs wanting to stretch budget with PSG funding, as covered in our[guide to choosing HR software in Singapore](https://briohr.com/blog/a-guide-to-choosing-hr-software-singapore/) .


## Swingvy: Best for Mobile-First Clinic and Home-Care Teams


Swingvy combines core HR administration and payroll in a modern, mobile-led interface. It is commonly chosen by SMEs moving off spreadsheets that want something staff will actually open, rated 4.0 out of 5 on usability in independent comparisons.


For community nursing, home-care visits, and multi-site clinic cover, the mobile app is the practical selling point.


### Swingvy Key Features


#### Geofenced Mobile Clock-In and Shift Scheduling


iOS and Android apps handle leave requests, claims, and clock-ins with GPS and geofencing, plus shift scheduling and overtime tracking. Staff visiting patients at home can clock in at the door rather than back at base, and location data is attached to the record.


#### Dual-Country Statutory Payroll


Swingvy runs native Malaysian payroll with EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, HRD Corp, EA Form, and LHDN e-filing, alongside Singaporean CPF, SDL, IR8A, and IR21. Leave, claims, and attendance link to payroll, and public holiday calendars sync for both countries.


### Swingvy Pricing


Plan Details


Premium (HR Hub, Leave, Claims) From RM8.50 per user per month


Payroll module From RM8.50 per user per month, billed separately


Minimum Five users, with a discount for annual billing


### Where Swingvy Shines


- Adoption across non-desk staff: the mobile experience is clean enough that healthcare assistants and part-timers use it without a training session, which decides whether attendance data is trustworthy
- Solid daily HR coverage for the price: leave, claims, attendance, and payroll in one place with full Malaysian and Singaporean statutory support
- Cleaner interface than most legacy local tools: reviewers consistently call out ease of use over feature count


### Where Swingvy Falls Short


- Rotating shift support is partial: it handles shift scheduling, but complex rotating rosters with alternating night patterns need more manual work than in a purpose-built rostering tool
- No recruitment or applicant tracking: job posting, resume parsing, interview scheduling, and offer letters all require separate tools
- Thin learning and performance layers: no training records, course catalogue, certification tracking, or HRD Corp levy tracking, and performance stops at basic review cycles and self-assessment
- No biometric or facial recognition, and no managed payroll: hardware clock-in points and payroll outsourcing are both outside its scope

## Workday HCM: Best for Large Hospital Networks and Multi-Entity Groups


Workday is a full enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) platform used by Fortune 500 organisations worldwide, including large health systems. It covers HR, payroll, recruitment, onboarding, performance, learning and development, analytics, and workforce planning across multi-entity, multi-currency, and multi-language operations.


For a hospital network running several legal entities across countries, it is the option built for that shape of problem.


### Workday HCM Key Features


#### Workforce Planning and Predictive Analytics


Headcount modelling, attrition analysis, skills matrices, succession planning, and predictive analytics support long-range clinical workforce planning: how many theatre nurses you will need in three years, and where the retirement cliff sits. Few platforms in this market attempt that.


#### Full Talent and Learning Suite


OKRs, KPI tracking, 360 feedback, calibration, performance improvement plans, career pathing, continuous feedback, e-learning, course catalogues, and certification tracking are all native. For organisations running mandatory clinical competency programmes, that breadth is genuinely useful.


### Workday HCM Pricing


Plan Details


Enterprise HCM Custom quote only, commonly entering around USD $100,000 annually for mid-market bands


Model Annual or multi-year subscription per worker, plus separate implementation and integration cost


### Where Workday Shines


- End-to-end coverage with almost no functional gaps: HR, payroll, talent, learning, analytics, and planning in one platform
- Built for genuine enterprise complexity: multi-entity, multi-currency, multi-language, with global payroll and employer-of-record workflows for cross-border clinical staffing
- Long track record and stability: one of the most established HCM platforms, which matters to hospital boards and IT governance committees


### Where Workday Falls Short


- Cost is out of reach for most healthcare SMEs: six-figure annual contracts plus implementation are difficult for a clinic group or single nursing home to justify
- Rollout takes 12 to 24 months: a long runway before the system is live, during which your current problems continue
- Malaysian and Singaporean payroll is configured, not native: EA Form, LHDN e-filing, and bank direct credit are only partially supported, and HRD Corp or SBL-Khas tracking is absent
- No local MY or SG support hours: support runs on global time zones, which is a real friction point during a local payroll cut-off
- Needs dedicated internal resource: HRIS, IT, and configuration staff are effectively a requirement

### Who Workday Is Best For


Hospital networks and healthcare groups above roughly 10,000 employees with dedicated HRIS, IT, and change-management teams, and a multi-year budget for implementation. ## Employment Hero: Best for Healthcare Employers Prioritising Engagement and Retention


Employment Hero is an HR and payroll platform built around a wide employee engagement ecosystem. Alongside core administration it includes recruitment, onboarding, performance management, pulse surveys, and recognition, which is the broadest horizontal coverage in this comparison.


Given how much healthcare turnover costs, engagement tooling in the same place as admin is a reasonable priority.


### Employment Hero Key Features


#### Pulse Surveys and Recognition


Built-in engagement surveys, recognition, and announcement feeds let a practice manager check how a shift-heavy team is coping without commissioning a separate survey tool. Results sit next to the employee record rather than in a standalone dashboard.


#### Employee Self-Service Across the Lifecycle


Onboarding, document acknowledgement, leave, timesheets, claims, and reporting run through a self-service portal with a well-regarded interface, rated 4.0 out of 5 on usability. It reduces the administrative chase that usually falls on one person.


### Employment Hero Pricing


Plan Details


HR plans From around USD $10 per employee per month, with a minimum monthly spend


Rostering and attendance Charged as a separate add-on module


Malaysia guidance Roughly RM8 to RM12 per employee per month, with a monthly minimum


### Where Employment Hero Shines


- Widest feature breadth in this list: recruitment, onboarding, performance, payroll, engagement, and recognition under one subscription
- Strong employee experience: self-service and engagement features are the product's clearest strength, and adoption tends to be good
- Useful for retention work: having survey data, performance records, and turnover reporting in one place makes it easier to connect a resignation pattern to a cause


### Where Employment Hero Falls Short


- Payroll and HR are not one product: payroll was acquired separately and still requires a separate login, which creates friction exactly where healthcare employers need reliability
- Weaker MY and SG localisation: support consistency and statutory depth lag regional specialists, and the product is strongest in Australia and the UK
- Rostering costs extra: time, attendance, and rostering are a paid add-on rather than part of the core plan, which changes the real price for shift-based teams
- Longer implementation and no PSG eligibility: rollouts commonly run around six months, and Singapore SMEs cannot offset cost with grant funding

Onboarding is also well covered, including pre-boarding, checklists, task assignment, and document collection.


**Key features:** full EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, and HRD Corp support with religious leave types and Malaysian public holiday sync · digital onboarding flows · OKRs and 360 feedback · asset management, which is handy for tracking issued devices and clinical equipment.

## What Features Should Healthcare Organizations Look for in an HR Platform?


Healthcare has requirements most HR buying guides skip. These are the four that decide whether a platform survives its first year in a clinical setting.


### Rotating-Shift Rostering That Survives Real Coverage Changes


Ward rosters are not weekly repeats. Nights alternate, staff swap at short notice, part-timers cover across two sites, and overtime rules differ by contract type.


Ask any vendor to demonstrate a rotating pattern with a mid-week swap, then show the resulting timesheet and the overtime calculation. Many tools handle scheduling and attendance separately, which means somebody reconciles them by hand every month.


> "HR software is the only software used by everyone in the company... some people might say now it's email. No, in F&B most people don't have a company email or in construction, however, they clock in and out every day, they get their pay slips."


**[Benjamin Croc](https://my.linkedin.com/in/benjamin-croc-93669426)


The same holds in healthcare. A healthcare assistant may never open a work email, but she clocks in every shift and needs her payslip.


brioHR handles rotating patterns, geofenced mobile clock-in, facial recognition, and biometric hardware in one attendance module, and approved hours move into payroll without an export.


Bring us your messiest roster.[Request a demo](https://briohr.com/book-demo/) and we will build it live, including the swap that always breaks your current spreadsheet.


### Payroll That Handles Multiple Cycles and Statutory Detail


A hospital or clinic group often runs monthly salaried payroll, a separate hourly or weekly cycle, locum payments, and shift differentials in the same month.


Check that the platform supports multiple pay frequencies natively, calculates every statutory item for your country, generates the year-end forms, and updates rates automatically when the law changes. Singapore employers should confirm CPF handling specifically, and our summary of[CPF contribution updates](https://briohr.com/blog/cpf-updates-singapore/) shows how often these shift.


Two useful reads before you decide:[how payroll software reduces cost](https://briohr.com/blog/payroll-software-save-money/) and which platforms handle[automated payroll](https://briohr.com/blog/best-automated-payroll-software/) well. brioHR supports[multi-cycle payroll](https://briohr.com/blog/multi-cycle-payroll-software-helps-retail-fandb-businesses/) with attendance, leave, and claims feeding each run.


### Leave and Absence Rules That Match Clinical Reality


Healthcare leave is complicated: hospitalisation leave, unplanned sick leave that immediately creates a coverage gap, replacement leave for public holiday shifts, and carry-forward rules that differ by grade.


The platform should support custom leave types, accrual rules, multi-level approval, carry-forward and expiry, and replacement leave, then reflect the balance on the roster so a manager sees the gap before the shift starts. Singapore employers can cross-check requirements against our guide to the[14 types of leave every HR in Singapore should know](https://briohr.com/blog/14-types-of-leave-every-hr-in-singapore-should-know/) , and[absenteeism](https://briohr.com/blog/employee-absenteeism/) covers the patterns worth monitoring.


brioHR's[leave and time-off module](https://briohr.com/products/products/leave-and-time-off/) covers all of the above and shares a calendar with attendance, so approved absence and roster coverage stay in sync.


### Document Retention, Security, and Audit Trails


Practising certificates expire. Vaccination records get requested. Disciplinary files need to be produced years later, complete and unaltered.


Look for role-based permissions granular enough that a unit manager sees her team's records but not the whole organisation's, document storage tied to the employee file, e-signature for contracts and variations, and a full audit log of access and changes. ISO 27001 certification is a reasonable baseline given the sensitivity of the data involved, and brioHR's[security controls](https://briohr.com/security/) set out what that covers in practice.

## How We Selected the Best Healthcare HR Software


Our criteria deliberately differ from the feature checklist above. These are the tests we applied to each platform as a product and a vendor.


### Local Statutory Accuracy, Verified Not Claimed


We checked whether payroll engines are native to Malaysia and Singapore or delivered through a partner or configuration layer, and whether statutory forms and e-filing are generated in-platform. Partner-delivered payroll is not disqualifying, but it changes who you call when a contribution rate is wrong three days before cut-off. We also looked at whether statutory updates roll out automatically.


### Usability for Non-Desk Clinical Staff


A healthcare HR platform fails quietly when a night-shift assistant stops clocking in properly because the app is confusing. We weighted mobile experience, self-service clarity, and independent usability scores heavily, and we discounted feature counts that assume an office worker with a laptop.

#### FAQs


1


** ** What Is the Best Overall HR Software for Healthcare?


There is no single answer, because size decides it. For clinic groups, nursing homes, and mid-sized hospitals in Malaysia and Singapore, brioHR covers the widest set of healthcare-specific needs in one platform. Above 10,000 employees, Workday HCM is the more appropriate option.


2


** ** Can HR Software Manage Hospital Patients?


No. HR platforms manage staff, not patients. Patient records, appointments, and billing belong in an electronic medical record or practice-management system. The two are usually kept separate for privacy and regulatory reasons, and none of the platforms in this guide handle clinical data.


3


** ** Does Healthcare HR Software Help With Compliance?


Yes, on the employment side. It handles statutory payroll contributions, leave entitlements, working-hour records, contract documentation, and audit trails. Clinical accreditation and licensing compliance sit outside HR software, though credential documents and expiry dates can be stored and tracked in the employee file.


4


** ** How Much Does Healthcare HR Software Cost?


It ranges widely. Entry-level local platforms start from around RM3 to RM10 per employee per month, mid-market Singapore tools from about S$5 per employee per month, and enterprise HCM systems commonly begin near USD $100,000 annually plus implementation. Singapore SMEs can offset up to 50% with PSG funding on eligible platforms.


5


** ** Is HR Software Suitable for Small Medical Practices?


Yes. A practice with 10 to 30 staff still runs payroll, leave, and attendance, and usually has one person doing all three by hand. Lower-cost platforms such as HReasily or altHR suit that scale, while brioHR is built for practices with more complex shift and multi-entity needs.


6


** ** Can Healthcare HR Software Integrate With Other Systems?


Sometimes. Most platforms in this guide integrate with accounting software, and several offer API access. Integration with clinical systems is rarer and usually needs custom development. Confirm specific integrations with the vendor before signing, and ask whether API access is included in your tier or charged separately.
